identity.title: Perry Nuclear Power Plant, Docket No. 50-440, License No. NPF-58: Licensee Event Report Submittal

cause.proximate_text: Cause 1: A series of human performance errors during the preparation, review, and approval of SOI-E12 RHR Rev 80 being implemented as a Simple Change. Cause 2: Communication of vital information between Operations and Engineering that could have directly prevented the procedure change leading to the plant being operated in an unanalyzed condition was not effective. Contributing Cause: Previous evaluations of the same requested procedure change to make RHR operable using Alternate Keepfill missed the opportunity to embed guidance in SOI-E12 that clearly states that this change does not support Design Basis Criteria (SACF) USAR Chapter 15 Requirements.
cause.theme: Procedure revision error and ineffective Operations/Engineering communication

nodes.display_name: RHR Waterleg Pump (loops B and C)
SOI-E12 "Residual Heat Removal System" Operating Procedure
SOI-E12 Rev 80 deleted RHR inoperability directives for alternate keep fill / waterleg pump outage
nodes.description: Revision 80 removed the precaution and procedure step requiring operators to declare an RHR loop inoperable when on alternate keep fill or with waterleg pump shutdown.

nodes.display_name: Ineffective communication between Operations and Engineering
nodes.description: Vital information that could have prevented the procedure change from being implemented was not effectively communicated between Operations and Engineering.

nodes.display_name: RHR loops B and C not declared inoperable per revised procedure
nodes.description: Operators followed SOI-E12 Rev 80 and did not declare RHR loops B and C inoperable when the waterleg pump was declared inoperable on March 25, 2024.

nodes.display_name: RHR B/C loops operated in alternate keep fill configuration
nodes.description: Alternate keep fill startup using non-safety Condensate Transfer and Storage System water was established for RHR loops B and C, relying on check valves to perform an active isolation function not credited by the licensing basis.

nodes.display_name: Operation in condition prohibited by Technical Specifications (TS 3.5.1 Conditions A/C/D not entered)
Operation in unanalyzed condition (alternate keep fill check valve credited with active isolation function)
Revise SOI-E12 (Rev 81 and Rev 82) to restore licensing-basis inoperability requirements
Develop and implement WELL sheet for procedure preparation, 50.59 RAD, and Screen processes
Develop and deliver training case study on communications
Anchor reason for RHR inoperability on Alternate Keepfill to SOI-E12
Anchor reason for RHR inoperability on Alternate Keepfill to inservice testing program procedure

chain: human performance errors in SOI-E12 Rev 80 procedure revision [cause TBD] -> ineffective Operations/Engineering communication -> RHR loops B/C not declared inoperable (TS violation) & RHR B/C operated on alternate keep fill (unanalyzed condition, check valve credited with active isolation function) -> plant operated outside licensing basis for ~5 days [backup: RHR loop A remained operable throughout]
notes: Cause code left TBD/provisional per FORM-366 fields; narrative gives detailed Cause 1/Cause 2/Contributing Cause statements captured in proximate_text and split into two parallel FailureMode branches (procedural failure to declare inoperable -> TS-prohibited condition; and alternate keep fill configuration itself -> unanalyzed condition) both stemming from the same root procedure-revision failure. RHR loop A explicitly stated to have 'remained operable... throughout this event' and is modeled as BACKED_UP_BY. Condensate Transfer and Storage System [KA] is modeled as an involved system (not mere design context) because it was the actual water source used during the event's alternate keep fill configuration. No previous similar events were reported (section states 'None'), so no stub LER/SIMILAR_TO edge created. Block 13 was empty in FORM-366 fields, consistent with narrative's blank/checkbox-only Block 13 table.
